video_title: Wolves' TV & Kuminga | The Jon Krawczynski Show

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves will stream local games on the Bally Sports app via the new DSN channel
quotes.excerpt: they are going to stream all of their local games on the DSN channel
quotes.quote: The Timberwolves finally came out with their plan for this next season late last week. They are going to stream all of their local games, not the ones that are distributed on NBC Peacock or ABC ESPN or Prime, on the DSN channel. There are a couple of things that Wolves fans need to know about what this setup is going to look like. They are going to charge a monthly subscription on DSN. They have not yet announced the price tag of that, and so we will see exactly where they come out on it.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: The new DSN streaming package will not be available on cable or satellite
quotes.excerpt: this package is not going to be available on cable or satellite
quotes.quote: The one really important thing to remember and to know if you are looking for the Wolves games next year is that this package is not going to be available on cable or satellite. You are going to have to just stream it on your smart TV, on your tablet, on your phone, anything like that. If you subscribe to Comcast like I do, if you subscribe to DirecTV, if you are anything, any of those types of linear options for your TV viewing, there is not going to be a DSN channel that carries Timberwolves games.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: 15 Timberwolves games will be available for free on the DSN app
quotes.excerpt: 15 of the games are going to be free
quotes.quote: One thing that was brought up, which I think is important to raise, is that 15 of the games are going to be free. The Timberwolves are still looking at possibly partnering with over-the-air, like they did with KARE 11 last year, for distribution of some of those games, but there will be 15 games on the DSN app that are offered free.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA teams without local deals may eventually be aggregated under one roof
quotes.excerpt: the NBA is going to take as many of the teams that are without their own specific deal
quotes.quote: There is a stated belief from the NBA next season that after this season, the 2027-28 season, the NBA is going to take as many of the teams that are without their own specific deal locally under one roof and trying to distribute the games that way. DSN is a leading contender to be the apparatus, the platform that is aggregating all of these different teams.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles is a top MVP candidate for the Minnesota Lynx
quotes.excerpt: Olivia Miles is the front runner or deserves to be the front runner

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Now I am starting to think that Olivia Miles is the front runner or deserves to be the front runner. She is the best player on by far the best team.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I saw someone mention this yesterday, and I cannot remember who it was, but it was not my original thought. But when you think about the impact that she has made as a rookie, it feels like Randy Moss. It feels like a team that entered the season where you did not really have incredibly high expectations, given all of the players the Lynx lost, given Napheesa Collier's injury, given Asia Durr's injury. You said, all right, it is going to be a fine season, and then out of nowhere, Olivia Miles has just kind of taken this whole thing up seven levels.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves have expressed interest in Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.excerpt: the Wolves have emerged as a team that has expressed interest in Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.quote: There was a report from my friend Mike Scotto at HoopsHype last week that the Wolves have emerged as a team that has expressed interest in Jonathan Kuminga. What I can say to that is very much similar to a lot of the scenarios out there with many free agents over the years. When someone is available, especially at a position of need, yes, the Wolves are interested in trying to get involved in the sweepstakes there.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves face salary cap constraints in pursuing Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.excerpt: they only have a minimum offer to extend to Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.quote: What is going to be very difficult for them in this scenario is that they only have a minimum offer to extend to Jonathan Kuminga. One of the things that has been made clear by Kuminga's camp to anyone that is expressing interest in him is that he wants a good chunk of money. It is hard for me to see a scenario where the Wolves get involved at anything over the minimum. I just do not see any really avenues for them to get involved that way.
